throughline.zh: 本週台灣與東南亞陸續公布資料中心工程與供電規劃、半導體測試設施試運轉及光通訊研發合作，已完工設施與未來目標均分別標示。
throughline.en: This week's Taiwan and Southeast Asian releases cover operating data centers, power plans, chip-testing trials and photonics research, with completed capacity distinguished from future targets.

title.zh: 馬來西亞資料中心投資、印尼機房與電力供應
title.en: Malaysia data-center investment, Indonesian facilities and power

summary.zh: Google 11 月 4 日公布馬來西亞 2027 至 2028 年投資 150 億美元的計畫；LG CNS 與 NTT DATA 分別揭露雅加達 30MW 已完工設施及 12MW IT 容量新機房。台電另說明未來十年天然氣新機組規劃，鴻海亞灣超算與越南宏于電機則公布既有供電、液冷與配電設施進度。
summary.en: Google announced planned US$15B Malaysian investment for 2027–28, while LG CNS and NTT DATA detailed a completed 30MW Jakarta facility and a new site with 12MW of IT capacity. Taipower outlined future gas capacity, and Foxconn Visionbay and Horng Yu discussed cooling and electrical infrastructure.

title.zh: 光子封裝、高速光通訊與 AI 晶片
title.en: Photonic packaging, optical links and AI chip design

summary.zh: 毅嘉公布馬來西亞光通訊產品通過客戶認證，台荷 11 月 4 日公布 4 項共同光子研發合作，涉及先進封裝與 3.2T 光收發模組。TrendForce 公布 2027 年互連市場預測，聯發科另提出 AI ASIC 市占預測，均須與已實現出貨區分。
summary.en: IChia reported qualified Malaysian optical products, while Taiwan and the Netherlands detailed four photonics R&D projects covering packaging and 3.2T optics. TrendForce's interconnect estimates and MediaTek's AI ASIC outlook remain forecasts rather than realized shipments.

title.zh: 越南晶片測試試產、半導體貿易與設備投資
title.en: Vietnam chip-testing trials, chip trade and equipment investment

summary.zh: FPT 11 月 3 日公布北寧封測廠開始試運轉，最大設計年產能為 3 億顆，實際出貨與良率尚未揭露。南韓對東協半導體出口統計及台灣第三季半導體設備進口增長，提供不同日期的區域供應鏈背景。
summary.en: FPT began trial operations at its Bac Ninh test and packaging facility with nameplate capacity of 300 million chips per year; shipments and yields are undisclosed. Korea's ASEAN semiconductor exports and Taiwan's Q3 equipment imports provide separately dated regional context.

title.zh: 電子製造景氣、記憶體缺料與電源供應商財報
title.en: Electronics manufacturing, memory constraints and power-supply earnings

summary.zh: 11 月初的台灣、馬來西亞及越南製造業 PMI 調查呈現不同的新訂單與交期情況。群光電能 11 月 4 日公布第三季營收 74.14 億元，指出筆電記憶體與伺服器測試設備短缺影響部分產品供應。
summary.en: Early-November manufacturing PMI releases described differing order flows and supplier delivery times across Taiwan, Malaysia and Vietnam. Chicony Power reported Q3 revenue of NT$7.414B and linked shipment delays to notebook memory and server test-equipment shortages.

title.zh: 台灣核能設備合資、研發投入與跨境供應鏈
title.en: Taiwan energy-equipment venture, R&D and cross-border supply chains

summary.zh: 華新麗華等 4 家企業 11 月 3 日簽約成立核能設備供應鏈合資公司，尚未公開資本額與訂單。台灣此前公布研發支出統計及日商會對半導體材料與設備供應鏈的看法，資料各有原始發布日期。
summary.en: Four Taiwan companies signed a November 3 nuclear-equipment venture agreement without disclosing capital or orders. Previously reported R&D spending and Japanese industry observations on semiconductor materials and equipment provide dated context.
